**The Steam and GOG game files work properly.** The DOOM, DOOM II, TNT and
Plutonia files sold today (the 2019 and 2024 re-releases) carry widescreen
versions of the title pages, help and credit screens, intermission maps,
end screens and status bar. DERP skipped these wider pictures, so the
title screen stayed black with menu pages piling up on top of each other,
and the status bar lost its grey background (issue #18). They are now
drawn centered, showing the classic 4:3 middle. The episode 3 ending's
scrolling picture lines up again too. The original DOS files were not
affected.
